title: Improve the planet model, only on verified gains
summary: Agents propose changes to the planet classifier; the referee keeps only gains that hold on stars no agent saw, and checks itself first.
goal: Find more real planets per telescope follow-up, using only model changes that survive all five gates.
reviewWhen: Every 6 hours, and at once if the self-test fails or NASA resolves a candidate we ranked.
agentInstructions: Run one cycle with `.venv/bin/python loop/tick.py` from the project root. It runs the self-test, pulls NASA dispositions, runs one guarded agent round (`exo/swarm.py --tag exo-loop`), rebuilds and deploys the site (`loop/deploy.sh` to redshift.egbe.app), writes `egbe-docs/reports/loop-<time>.md` and syncs artifacts. On this Mac a launchd job (`com.exoreferee.loop`) runs it every 6 hours.

steps.description: Plant three cheats, run an honest control and attack the sandbox. Each must get its expected verdict.
bullets: LEAK, PRIOR and NOISE on the planted cheats

stages.title: Take in new data
stages.checkpoint: Every newly resolved candidate is scored against our ranking.

steps.description: Find Kepler candidates NASA has confirmed or rejected since our snapshot and score how our ranking did on them.

stages.title: Let agents try
stages.checkpoint: Each claim has a verdict and evidence.

steps.description: Each agent asks the prior-work Apify Actor for arXiv papers on its focus area.
An agent writes one change to the model, with a hypothesis and citations.
The change runs in a sandbox and faces CRASH, NOISE, LEAK, PRIOR and OVERFIT. The first gate it fails is its verdict.

stages.title: Ship and report
stages.checkpoint: The site shows the current model and a report reaches Egbe.

steps.description: Rebuild the results and publish them on redshift.egbe.app.
Write what was judged, what was promoted and what NASA resolved, then sync it to this business.

transitions.label: All 8 checks pass
transitions.description: The loop may judge agent claims this cycle.

transitions.label: A gate or the sandbox fails a check
transitions.description: No claim is judged until a person fixes the referee. The report says which check failed.

transitions.label: The claim passes all five gates
transitions.description: It becomes the new model, because its gain held on stars no agent has seen.
transitions.example: Centroid shifts in sigma: +0.0185 AUC on hidden stars

transitions.label: The claim fails a gate
transitions.description: The model stays as it was. Agents see the verdict next round, never a hidden-test number.
transitions.example: Catalog name: LEAK, still 0.999 on shuffled labels

terms.budget: Two Claude agents every 6 hours, on this Mac while it is awake. More agents, a faster cadence or new spending needs Volodymyr's approval.
